## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 9 outcomes and 14 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **38.2%**: 41% (bid 40 cents, ask 42 cents; 10 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **38.1%**: 24% (bid 22 cents, ask 26 cents; 556 contracts in 24 hours)
- **38.0%**: 12% (bid 11 cents, ask 12 cents; 23 contracts in 24 hours)
- **Below 37.9%**: 9% (bid 7 cents, ask 10 cents; 1 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **37.9%**: 6% (bid 5 cents, ask 6 cents; 1 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **38.3%**: 6% (bid 5 cents, ask 6 cents; 560 contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 38.5%**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 249 contracts in 24 hours)
- **38.5%**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 204 contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpapprove/trump-approval-rating/kxtrumpapprove-26oct04) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

We have no model of our own for this market, so the odds above are the traders' consensus and not an independent estimate. For calibration: in our sample of settled Politics markets, the Kalshi mid-price a day before close scored a Brier error of 0.0809 (a coin-flip price scores 0.25; lower is better).

## How does this market resolve?

> If Trump's RCP approval average is below 37.9% at exactly 1:00 PM ET on Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 4, 2026 at 16:59 UTC. Expected settlement: October 4, 2026 at 17:00 UTC. Settlement source: [RealClearPolitics](https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/POLITICALSTAT.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- New polling, official announcements or filings, and statements by the named officials.
- The publication schedule of the named poll or tracker.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 119 settled Politics markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.0809; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 4.9% of the time (41 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (8 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "Trump's RCP approval average on Oct 4, 2026"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies 38.2% at 41%, 38.1% at 24%, and 38.0% at 12%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpapprove/trump-approval-rating/kxtrumpapprove-26oct04.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 4, 2026 at 16:59 UTC and is expected to settle October 4, 2026 at 17:00 UTC, in about 21 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names RealClearPolitics (https://www.realclearpolling.com/polls/approval/donald-trump/approval-rating) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/POLITICALSTAT.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

Kalshi is a federally regulated exchange (a CFTC-designated contract market). Whether you can trade depends on your location and eligibility under Kalshi's terms. The market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpapprove/trump-approval-rating/kxtrumpapprove-26oct04.

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.
